{{ModBox}} '''Serration''' is a [[mod]] that increases the base damage of [[:Category:Primary Weapons|primary weapons]] (excluding [[:Category:Shotgun|shotguns]]) by 15% per rank, at a maximum of 165% at rank 10. ==Stats== {| class="emodtable" |+ Normal |- ! [[Mod#Mod Rank|Rank]] ! Effect ! [[Mod#Attributes|Cost]] |- | 0 || +15% || 4 |- | 1 || +30% || 5 |- | 2 || +45% || 6 |- | 3 || +60% || 7 |- | 4 || +75% || 8 |- | 5 || +90% || 9 |- | 6 || +105% || 10 |- | 7 || +120% || 11 |- | 8 || +135% || 12 |- | 9 || +150% || 13 |- | 10 || +165% || 14 |}
{| class="emodtable" |+ [[Flawed Mods|Flawed]] |- ! [[Mods#Mod Rank|Rank]] ! Effect ! [[Mods#Mod Power Cost|Cost]] |- | 0 || +10% || 2 |- | 1 || +20% || 3 |- | 2 || +30% || 4 |- | 3 || +40% || 5 |} ==Drop Locations== *An unranked Serration is given upon completion of [[The Teacher]] Quest. {{DropLocations}} ==Notes== *Serration damage is applied before any other damage type. Therefore, every other damage increasing mod benefits from Serration. E.g. a weapon with a base damage of 18 equipped with a rank 9 Serration mod (150%) would have a new base damage of 45: {{MathText|18 {{mul}} (1 + 1.5) {{eql}} 45}} **This new base damage will be what is used to calculate elemental damages. *When paired with other mods: **Multiplicatively stacks with [[Faction Damage Mods]] for a maximum of +244.5% damage. ***+310.75% for Primed Faction Damage Mods. **Additively stacks with {{M|Heavy Caliber}} for a maximum of +330% damage. **Stacks with {{M|Heavy Caliber}} and Faction Damage Mods for a total of +459% damage at max rank. ***+566.5% for Primed Faction Damage Mods. *At higher ranks the fusion cost of this mod becomes quite costly. Upgrading other mods simultaneously makes for a better investment of your {{Resource|Endo}} compared to only enhancing this one alone. **It is suggested to upgrade this mod to at least rank 5 quickly though, since it is useful on a lot of weapons. **Maxing this mod requires 20,460 {{Resource|Endo}} and {{cc|988,218}}. {{clr}} ==Gallery== ModSerration.png|Old appearance ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|32.2}} *Fixed Drop Location text overlapping in the Codex when viewing the following Mods: **Serration {{ver|10.1.2}} *Fixed Serration mod not affecting Torid damage. {{ver|Vanilla}} *Introduced. }} {{DamageModsNav}} __NOTOC__ [[de:Einkerbung]] [[es:Sierra]] [[fr:Dentelure]] [[pt:Serration]] [[ru:Зазубрины]] [[Category:Mods]] [[Category:Uncommon Mods]] [[Category:Damage Mods]] [[Category:Rifle Mods]] [[Category:Madurai Mods]] [[Category:Flawed Mods]] [[uk:Зубець]] [[Category:Update 14]]

[[Fire rate]] (Rifles) ! [[Fire rate]] (Bows) ! [[Mod#Attributes|Cost]] |- | 0 || +10% || +20% || 4 |- | 1 || +20% || +40% || 5 |- | 2 || +30% || +60% || 6 |- | 3 || +40% || +80% || 7 |- | 4 || +50% || +100% || 8 |- | 5 || +60% || +120% || 9 |}
{| class="emodtable" |+ [[Flawed Mods|Flawed]] |- ! [[Mod#Mod Rank|Rank]] ! [[Fire rate]] (Rifles) ! [[Fire rate]] (Bows) ! [[Mod#Attributes|Cost]] |- | 0 || +5% || +10% || 2 |- | 1 || +10% || +20% || 3 |- | 2 || +15% || +30% || 4 |- | 3 || +20% || +40% || 5 |} ==Drop Locations== {{DropLocations}} ==Notes== *Can be combined with {{M|Vile Acceleration}}, {{M|Spring-Loaded Chamber}}, {{M|Vigilante Fervor}} and {{M|Primed Shred}} to provide a '''330%''' ('''660%''' for Bows) increase in fire rate while aiming, otherwise '''255% '''('''510% '''for bows) *Can decrease the [[Fire Rate#Charged Weapons|delay]] on Chargeable weapons such as {{Weapon|Dread}}, {{Weapon|Paris Prime}}, {{Weapon|Lanka}}, {{Weapon|Miter}} and {{Weapon|Ogris}}. *Has no visual effect on continuous weapons (e.g. the {{Weapon|Flux Rifle}} and {{Weapon|Ignis}}) as they shoot out a continuous beam. The number of damage instances will increase with higher fire rate. ==Gallery== SpeedTriggerMod.png|Old appearance ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|Vanilla}} *Introduced. }} {{FireRateMods}} [[de:Schnellauslöser]] [[es:Gatillo veloz]] [[pt:Speed Trigger]] [[ru:Скоростной Курок]] [[Category:Mods]] [[Category:Uncommon Mods]] [[Category:Fire Rate Mods]] [[Category:Rifle Mods]] [[Category:Madurai Mods]] [[Category:Flawed Mods]] [[uk:Швидкий гачок]] [[fr:Détente Rapide]] [[Category:Update 14]]

{{ModBox}} '''Slip Magazine''' is a [[mod]] that increases [[magazine capacity]] of a pistol by 5% per rank for a maximum of 30% at rank 5. ==Stats== {| class="emodtable" |+ Normal |- ! [[Mods#Mod Rank|Rank]] ! Effect ! [[Mods#Mod Power Cost|Cost]] |- | 0 || +5% || 4 |- | 1 || +10% || 5 |- | 2 || +15% || 6 |- | 3 || +20% || 7 |- | 4 || +25% || 8 |- | 5 || +30% || 9 |}
{| class="emodtable" |+ [[Flawed Mods|Flawed]] |- ! [[Mods#Mod Rank|Rank]] ! Effect ! [[Mods#Mod Power Cost|Cost]] |- | 0 || +2.5% || 2 |- | 1 || +5% || 3 |- | 2 || +7.5% || 4 |- | 3 || +10% || 5 |} ==Drop Locations== {{DropLocations}} ==Notes== *For any non-integer magazine values the magazine size is simply rounded to the nearest whole number. For example, a {{Weapon|Furis}} modded with a max rank '''Slip Magazine''' will have a calculated magazine size of {{Math|35 {{mul}} (1 + 30%)|t=y|bf-a=y}}, which will simply round to {{Math|35 {{mul}} (1 + 30%)|round|0|bf-a=y}}. *Is completely inferior to {{M|Ice Storm}} which can give a larger increase to Magazine Capacity (40%) and a 40% increase in Cold damage for the exact same mod capacity cost. ==Trivia== *Prior to {{ver|16.7}}, this mod was usable in [[PvP]] games until it was replaced by its own specific PvP mods along with a number of other mods: {{M|Quickdraw}}, {{M|Fast Hands}}, {{M|Tactical Pump}}, {{M|Steady Hands}}, {{M|Stabilizer}}, {{M|Burdened Magazine}}, {{M|Magazine Warp}} and {{M|Terminal Velocity}}. ==Gallery== SlipMagazineModOld.png|Old appearance ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|Vanilla}} *Introduced. }} {{AmmoNav}} __NOTOC__ [[de:Streifenmagazin]] [[es:Desliz de cargador]] [[pt:Slip Magazine]] [[fr:Chargeur Glissant]] [[ru:Скользящий Магазин]] [[Category:Mods]] [[Category:Pistol Mods]] [[Category:Clip Size Mods]] [[Category:Common Mods]] [[Category:Naramon Mods]] [[Category:Flawed Mods]] [[uk:Гнучкий магазин]] [[Category:Update 14]]

For example, an {{Weapon|Astilla}} modded with a max rank '''Shell Compression''' will have a calculated maximum ammo capacity of {{Math|112 {{mul}} (1 + 90%)|t=y|bf-a=y}}, which will round down to {{Math|floor|112 {{mul}} (1 + 90%)|bf-a=y}}. ==Gallery== ShellCompressionMod.png|Old appearance ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|33.0.1}} *Fixed the Shell Compression Mod having an unintentionally high drop rate in The Circuit tiers. {{ver|26}} *Shell Compression increased to +90% Ammo. *Is now an Exilus Weapon mod. {{ver|Vanilla}} *Introduced. }} {{AmmoNav}} __NOTOC__ [[es:Cartucho comprimido]] [[de:Patronenverdichtung]] [[ru:Укладка Боеприпасов]] [[Category:Mods]] [[Category:Shotgun Mods]] [[Category:Uncommon Mods]] [[Category:Naramon Mods]] [[Category:Exilus Weapon Mods]] [[Category:Flawed Mods]] [[uk:Ущільнення набоїв]] [[fr:Balles Comprimées]] [[Category:Update 14]]

{{ModBox}} '''Tactical Pump''' is a shotgun mod that increases [[reload speed]]. ==Stats== {| class="emodtable" |+ Normal |- ! [[Mod#Mod Rank|Rank]] ! Effect ! [[Mod#Attributes|Cost]] |- | 0 || +10% || 2 |- | 1 || +20% || 3 |- | 2 || +30% || 4 |- | 3 || +40% || 5 |- | 4 || +50% || 6 |- | 5 || +60% || 7 |}
{| class="emodtable" |+ [[Flawed Mods|Flawed]] |- ! [[Mod#Mod Rank|Rank]] ! Effect ! [[Mod#Attributes|Cost]] |- | 0 || +3% || 2 |- | 1 || +6% || 3 |- | 2 || +9% || 4 |- | 3 || +12% || 5 |} ==Drop Locations== {{DropLocations}} ==Notes== *The calculation of reload time using reload speed is: {{MathText|Reload Time {{eql}} Base Reload Time {{div}} (1 + Reload Speed Bonus)}} **For example, {{Weapon|Tigris}}' new reload time with a max-ranked Tactical Pump would be {{Math|1.8s / (1 + 60%)|t=y|mt-a=y}}s *Sustained DPS is increased by reload speed modifiers at the same rate as [[Ammo#Magazine Capacity|magazine size]] modifiers. *Can be combined with {{M|Chilling Reload}} and {{M|Seeking Fury}} for a maximum 115% reload speed bonus, granting an approximate '''{{Math|100% - (1 / [1 + 115%])|p=y}}''' reduction of reload time. ==Trivia== *Prior to {{ver|16.7}}, this mod was usable in [[PvP]] games until it was replaced by its own specific PvP mods. ==Gallery== TacticalPumpModOld.png|Old appearance ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|32}} *Tactical Pump: Increased reload speed from 30% to 60%. }} ==See also== *{{M|Fast Hands}}, the rifle version of this mod. *{{M|Quickdraw}}, the sidearm version of this mod. *{{M|Primed Tactical Pump}}, the primed counterpart. *{{M|Seeking Fury}}, a mod that increases [[punch through]] and Reload Speed. *{{M|Chilling Reload}}, a mod that increases Cold damage and Reload Speed. {{ReloadSpeedModsNav}} __NOTOC__ [[de:Taktisches Laden]] [[es:Bombeo táctico]] [[pt:Tactical Pump]] [[ru:Тактическая Помпа]] [[Category:Mods]] [[Category:Shotgun Mods]] [[Category:Uncommon Mods]] [[Category:Update 7]] [[Category:Naramon Mods]] [[Category:Flawed Mods]] [[uk:Тактичний подавач]] [[Category:Update 14]]
